components.name: Aluminium electrolytic capacitor
components.description: Wound anode foil with a nanometre Al2O3 dielectric, electrolyte-soaked paper and cathode foil in a sealed aluminium can.

components.name: Axial inductor
components.description: Copper winding on a ferrite drum inside a ferrite sleeve that closes the magnetic path, coated in epoxy.

components.name: Carbon film resistor
components.description: Pyrolytic carbon film on a ceramic rod, spiral-cut to value, with pressed-on caps and lacquer.

components.name: Ceramic disc capacitor
components.description: High-K BaTiO3 disc with fired silver electrodes, soldered leads and an epoxy dip coat.

components.name: Chip resistor
components.description: RuO2 film on alumina, laser-trimmed, with Ni/Sn plated terminations.

components.name: Chip inductor
components.description: Printed Ag coil stacked through ferrite sheets, with 5-sided Ag/Ni/Sn terminations.

components.name: Ceramic chip capacitor (MLCC)
components.description: Interleaved Ni electrodes in BaTiO3 ceramic with 5-sided Cu/Ni/Sn terminations.

components.name: Trimmer potentiometer
components.description: Cermet track on alumina swept by a precious-metal wiper, turned through a worm gear by a 25-turn screw.

components.name: Tantalum capacitor
components.description: Porous sintered tantalum anode with a nanometre Ta2O5 dielectric, MnO2 / carbon / silver cathode, moulded in epoxy.
